projectDescription: An intelligent educational chatbot built with Streamlit and a neural network that helps students across all school subjects while motivating them to keep learning.
keyFeatures: AI-powered intent classification using a trained neural network (Keras/TensorFlow)
Pattern-matching fallback with keyword detection for robust responses
Support for 18+ school subjects including Math, Science, History, Literature, and more
Streamlit-based web UI with a galaxy-themed animated interface
PDF upload and text extraction for context-aware answers
Voice input via speech recognition and text-to-speech output
Gamification system with XP points, streaks, and level progression
Quick-action sidebar shortcuts (analogies, examples, quizzes, study tips)
Summary generator, quiz mode, memorization techniques, and motivation pages
publicApiSurface: query_pdf(question: str, pdf_text: str) -> str | None
training_chatbot.py (CLI script to retrain the model)
